note:
escalations is the ratchet. It counts write-shaped capabilities the table grants and the hardcoded checks deny. The ratchet only shrinks: a rise fails the gate, and a fall fails it too until re-banked, because a ratchet nobody re-banks stops ratcheting.

2026-08-25 RE-BANK, 28 -> 24. It went 28 -> 34 first, and that rise was NOT data drift: the rows were unchanged and 6bbdae50 (the field-officer caseload UI) rewrote crm7's src/hooks/usePermissions.ts after the previous bank, tightening the hardcoded model so six previously-matched grants became denied. crm7 migration 20260912000000 then revoked the ten capabilities that were not a question — every '.write' held by the role literally named 'viewer', 20 rows across both tenants — which took it to 24, below the old bank.

COMPARABLE CELLS ROSE 168 -> 196 in the same window, because the same commit added roles to the shared set. So the ratio improved more than the raw number suggests: 28/168 to 24/196.

2026-09-24 RE-BANK, 24 -> 40 (bsuite#3318 measure run 35954673711, estate promotion). This rise IS data, not code: the new rows were seeded by the BSU Permissions work that limited the grid to holdable portal roles (BSU #1281) — `manager` write rows created 2026-09-23 (Braden Group) and 2026-09-22 (FutureBuild Academy); FutureBuild `field_officer` / `field_manager` rows created 2026-09-22. Those are selected BSU defaults, which by standing ruling persist until an owner/developer overrides them in the BSU Permissions Manager; crm7's hardcoded usePermissions map is the second vocabulary (queued: crm7-usepermissions-second-vocabulary). COMPARABLE CELLS rose 196 -> 303 in the same window, so the ratio is 40/303 = 13.2% against 24/196 = 12.2% before.

NONE OF THE 40 IS ENFORCED BY THE DATABASE, measured rather than asserted: no public/private function body and no pg_policies expression references crm.contacts.write, crm.placements.write, training.assessments.write, training.qualifications.write, conduit.pipeline.write or payroll.timesheets.write (0 hits), with a positive control — the same probe finds 6 references to the capabilities that ARE enforced through current_user_has_capability (view_billing, manage_financial, confidential and forms capabilities). Each becomes live only when a crm7 function or policy starts calling current_user_has_capability for that id; that change must reconcile this list first.

2026-09-27 RE-BANK, 40 -> 26 (bsuite#3391 measure run 36263571146). This fall IS data: crm7 migrations 20261207540000/550000 were applied to production 2026-09-27 02:00 AWST (supabase-migrate run 36261038546). 540000 seeded role defaults equal to crm7's behaviour for every mapped capability, and 550000 set whole-grid-save rows for the 11 reused ids back to that behaviour (87 rows, each audited in audit_events), so the table and the hardcoded map now agree on 14 more write cells. COMPARABLE CELLS rose 303 -> 618 because the catalogue gained 78 crm7 ids; ratio 26/618 = 4.2% against 40/303 = 13.2%. The audit compares against crm7's hardcoded map, which crm7#2853 (merged to development 2026-09-27) stops using for access; retire or repoint this audit when that reaches production (plan-rperm item 10).
not_a_defect_count: A divergence is a question, not a defect. Either the table is wrong or the hardcoded check is, and deciding that is reconciliation work. This number sizes the work; it does not accuse either side.

what_the_24_are.member: 10 — arguable. A member writing contacts is a product question, not a defect.
what_the_24_are.gto_staff: 4 — probably correct; day-to-day GTO operators do write.
what_the_24_are.field_manager: 5 — arguably SHOULD be granted. The operator's own description of the role is that it edits caseloads across field officers, so the hardcoded side may be the one that is behind.
what_the_24_are.viewer: 0 — settled 2026-08-25. A role named 'viewer' holding a write was indefensible under any model, so it was the only group revoked without asking.

deliberately_not_reconciled: The remaining 24 are Braden's authorisation model. Clearing a red check is not a reason to change it, and this file exists to SIZE that work rather than to license doing it unilaterally.

what_the_40_are.member: 14 (Braden Group 5, FutureBuild Academy 4, Lookn 5) — unchanged question from the 24: a member writing contacts is a product call, not a defect. member is not a holdable portal_role, so effective_user_capabilities never reads these rows today.
what_the_40_are.field_officer: 9 (Braden Group 5, FutureBuild Academy 4) — BSU defaults grant writes the hardcoded map denies. A reconciliation question for the BSU Permissions Manager, not a verdict on either side.
what_the_40_are.field_manager: 9 (Braden Group 5, FutureBuild Academy 4) — same shape as field_officer; the role edits caseloads across field officers.
what_the_40_are.gto_staff: 4 (Braden Group 2, Lookn 2) — unchanged; gto_staff is not a holdable portal_role, so these rows are stored and never read.
what_the_40_are.manager: 4 (Braden Group 2, FutureBuild Academy 2) — NEW: training.assessments/qualifications.write, seeded 2026-09-22/23. A reconciliation question of the same kind.
